evals.prompt: We're starting work on this WordPress site. Map how it's built and set up the architecture docs.
evals.expected_output: A generated site inventory (md and json) and a hand-written architecture doc that explains each content type and template family, with open questions listed.
expectations: Ran ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/site.mjs and produced <inventory>.md and <inventory>.json dated today
Named the active theme and its parent theme from the inventory, not from assumptions
Looked up templates without display conditions and menus inside page-builder headers with read-only calls
The architecture doc covers every content type in the inventory and points to the inventory for lists
Made no write calls to the site

evals.prompt: Which plugins and theme does the site run, and which templates render the blog?
evals.expected_output: An answer drawn from the site inventory (rerun if missing or stale): active theme and parent, active plugins, and the templates that render single posts and the blog archive.
expectations: Used the existing inventory if current, or ran the script
Named the theme, its parent, and the page builder with versions
Identified the single-post and archive templates and their display conditions
Did not edit the architecture doc unless something in it was wrong

evals.prompt: We just switched a plugin and added a content type. Refresh the site docs.
evals.expected_output: A refreshed inventory, a git diff summary of what changed, and the architecture doc updated for the new content type.
expectations: Reran the script and compared the new inventory with the previous one (git diff)
Reported added, removed, or changed plugins, content types, and templates
Added the new content type to the architecture doc
Flagged anything that looks broken (dead conditions, inactive plugins still referenced)
